description: Report-style search over accounts, donations (includes pledges and pledge payments), activities or events. Give filter criteria (field + operator + value), the output columns to return (standard field NAMES as strings, or custom-field IDS as integers — both from neon_list_search_fields), and 0-based pagination. Results come back as searchResults rows keyed by output field name, plus pagination totals. Neon allows only ONE concurrent search per endpoint. Neon: POST /{resource}/search.

current_page.description: 0-based page number (Neon pages start at 0). Default 0.

output_fields.description: Columns to return: standard field names (strings) and/or custom-field ids (integers). Max 300.

search_fields.description: Filter criteria, ANDed together. Neon requires at least one.

field.description: A search field name, e.g. 'Email' or 'Donation Date'.

operator.description: Comparison operator. BLANK/NOT_BLANK take no value.

value_list.description: A list of values, for IN_RANGE / NOT_IN_RANGE.

sort_column.description: Output field name to sort by — it must also appear in output_fields.

name: neon_search
title: Search records
